title: The Long Way Home (smoke test)
premise: A dinner party has just ended. The listener and the speaker, established adults in a new relationship, take the long way home through quiet streets. Tasteful slow-burn: tension and warmth, nothing explicit.
beats: Leaving the party: recap the evening's private jokes, the looks across the table.
The detour: he admits the route home is not the fast one, and why.
The doorstep: unhurried, warm, asking rather than assuming.
